title: Test explicit HC-family lineage/factorization across hc-brain, God Brain, and Transcendence
claim: Exact byte and live-branch-topology evidence justifies a bounded lineage/factorization experiment across hc-brain, God Brain, and Transcendence. bt2 retains substantial HC-derived bytes but source-controlled BT2 provenance establishes a canonical Build Team Two platform role; bt2 is therefore retained as a historical-bootstrap control rather than an active HC factorization consumer.

consumers.role: current public HC reference subject; no implied semantic authority over derivatives
independent experimental derivative whose README explicitly states HC-template origin
independent HC-derived subject with measured exact reconstruction/overlay evidence and strong current byte overlap

preserved_boundaries: Repository identity, authority, scientific purpose, and qualification remain project-owned.
God Brain's simulation/contact research question is not inherited by HC and HC semantics are not automatically authoritative over God Brain.
Transcendence remains independently governed; prior pinned-base reconstruction evidence does not create moving-base inheritance.
bt2 is a canonical Build Team Two platform with HC-derived bootstrap ancestry; its retained HC bytes must not be used to infer current HC semantic authority.
No moving-base dependency, repository merge, branch rewrite, archive/delete action, or canonical-successor direction follows from static byte overlap.
promotion_evidence: At exact main heads, God Brain and hc-brain each contain 300 blobs; 299 same-path blobs are identical and only README.md differs.
The God Brain/HC identical blobs account for 2,181,434 of 2,191,461 hc-brain blob bytes (99.54245136%).
Current Transcendence main has 263 file paths, all present in current hc-brain; 255 are byte-identical and eight differ.
God Brain ↔ Transcendence measures 255 identical same-path blobs / 95.35251012% of the smaller repository byte surface.
HC, God Brain, and Transcendence share a 35-branch live namespace while exact same-named branch heads have diverged.

Portfolio-wide default-head scan covers all 253 unordered pairs across the 23 public repositories; only six pairs share any Git blob SHA, and those six are exactly the complete bt2/god-brain/hc-brain/transcendence clique.

bt2 ↔ HC still measures 178 identical same-path blobs and 46.14031461% of hc-brain bytes, but BT2 source provenance shows that overlap is bootstrap/history evidence rather than sufficient evidence of a current HC-template role.
experiments/BT2_HC_BOOTSTRAP_PROVENANCE_V1.json binds the BT2 role correction to exact source history and preserves the static overlap measurements.
rejection_conditions: Exact base-plus-overlay reconstruction cannot reproduce God Brain or Transcendence target trees without importing project-specific authority or unrelated state.
Forward changes show that maintaining a shared base requires more review, adapter, qualification, or migration work than independent copies.
The apparent HC/God Brain/Transcendence overlap is mostly historical snapshot provenance with no continuing maintenance duplication.
A factorized design would reduce either God Brain's or Transcendence's ability to diverge, falsify HC assumptions, or preserve independent research history.

New exact source evidence shows bt2 intentionally retains an active HC-template semantic role after its canonical Build Team Two platform declarations; until then bt2 remains a provenance control rather than an active consumer.

critical_objections: Static overlap is especially vulnerable to post-fork snapshot bias.
A large shared branch-name namespace is a provenance signal, not proof of ancestry direction or shared desired maintenance.
God Brain's near-total duplication may be transient and intentionally useful while the experiment establishes its own architecture.
Transcendence's prior overlay success does not prove that the same factorization economics apply to God Brain.
bt2 demonstrates why copied bytes and a stale root README cannot by themselves define current repository role.

notes: This candidate was generated from the live 2026-09-21 public census refresh rather than the prior seeded experiment queue.
Next valid active-lineage experiment: exact pinned-HC-plus-overlay reconstruction for current God Brain, followed by forward-change maintenance measurement.
Transcendence remains a distinct active lineage subject with prior exact reconstruction evidence and fresh current-head overlap measurements.
bt2 is retained outside the active consumer set as a historical-bootstrap/provenance control; any cleanup of HC-derived BT2 material requires a separate dependency audit.
Full public byte-identity scan still isolates the four-repository byte-overlap clique; this correction changes semantic interpretation, not the measured blob facts.
